gate_decisions.Approved for Development: Task meets all quality gates. Ready to enter development sprint.
gate_decisions.Needs Clarification: Task has minor gaps that must be resolved before development begins.
gate_decisions.Requires QA Review: Task lacks sufficient test plan or QA definition. QA lead must review.
gate_decisions.Requires Security Review: Task has security or compliance concerns. Security team must sign off.
gate_decisions.Requires Architecture Review: Task has architectural impact. Tech lead or architect must review.
gate_decisions.Blocked: Task cannot proceed. Blocking dependency or critical gap must be resolved first.
